messages:
Jordan: Hey, trying to add a service account to project zephyr-prod but the console throws a 403 when I click "Add member". I'm an org admin. Anyone seen this?
Amelia (Support): Are you on SSO / SCIM? Any recent role/group changes? Can you share org id and a quick screenshot (no tokens)?
Jordan: Using Okta SSO, role shows "Org Admin" in UI. Org id org_8421. Screenshot attached in ticket. https://…
Samir (SRE): Quick suspicion: SCIM group rename can leave an orphaned mapping. Can you open devtools → network → /auth/session and look for claims/groups? Any discrepancy between token groups and UI?
Jordan: Token shows groups: ["eng","zephyr-deploy"], missing org-admins. UI still shows me as Org Admin (cached). SCIM sync last success 2026-03-14 03:12 UTC.
Amelia (Support): UI can be stale. Try incognito to bypass browser cache. Also do not paste full tokens here. If you can run a membership refresh via API that helps: 
Samir (SRE): If you have the CLI or curl, run:

curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/org_8421/members/refresh" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY"

(Do this from a secure terminal, don't paste the key here.)
Jordan: Ran it, response 202 Accepted (refresh queued). Still 403 in console.
support-bot: [automated] Created support ticket #78912 and paged infra-oncall.
Samir (SRE): I see a SCIM group rename event two days ago: old 'org-admins' -> 'org-admins-core'. The SCIM mapping wasn't updated so role claim vanished for token issuance. There's also a lingering deny tag on org_8421: iam:deny=project:create that blocks member creation even for admins.
Amelia (Support): We'll remove the deny tag and trigger a forced resync. Jordan, can you try again in ~5 mins after we finish?
Samir (SRE): Done — removed deny tag and triggered resync at 3425000080. Confirmed SCIM mapping restored and token now includes 'org-admins-core' mapping to org_admin role.
Jordan: Tried again — add member flow works. No 403 now. Thanks!
Amelia (Support): Great. We'll open a short blameless postmortem and add a preflight for SCIM rename + automated mapping update, plus an alert if a deny tag is applied to an org. I'll follow up with the doc and remediation plan. :white_check_mark:
Jordan: Thanks everyone, appreciate the fast help.
